headline: Energy prices plunge led by natural gas and US crude
paragraphs: Natural gas experienced the sharpest drop today, falling 5.60% to €2.49 per MMBtu ($2.80) and extending a 12.54% weekly decline. The slump was driven by a drop in weather-related demand.

US crude also fell sharply, with WTI dropping 4.48% to €86.54 per barrel ($97.23). The downturn came as traders weighed supply recovery in the Gulf, alongside news that the US plans to loan roughly a third of its heating oil reserve to tame fuel costs.

On a weekly basis, silver stood out with a 4.32% gain to €51.58 per ounce ($57.95). The metal continued to show resilience, underpinned by silver exchange-traded fund holdings climbing to record levels.
